page.layout: One printed page. Top: running head "CYCLVS" with page number 6 at upper left; subtitle line "Feriarum, qui alias Cyclus Solis dicitur." Centre: a table with left label "Anni in hoc cyclo primi" and six year values, and a main table of letters with columns (Anni Bissextil., post biss. primi, post biss. secundi, post biss. tertij.). A vertical side inscription on the right margin. Below: running text paragraphs, a centred heading "Regula perpetua", a paragraph, and a small multiplication table with a vertical label "Tabella divisionis". Bottom right catchword "CALEN" and bottom left faint signature "A 3".

main_text.head: CYCLVS Feriarum, qui alias Cyclus Solis dicitur.
main_text.l: Anni Bissextil. | post biss. primi. | post biss. secundi. | post biss. tertij.
main_text.p: In anno bissextili prior litera in usu est usq; ad 24. Februarij cui mox post 25. Febr. succedit altera ad anni finem, diei Dominicæ index.
main_text.head: Regula perpetua.
main_text.p: Annos Christi divide per 28. residuo adde 9. rursus subducendo 28. si excreverit, habebis cyclum Solis. Vt Annus 1616. post divisionem relinquit 20. adjectis 9. sunt 29. quare annus est cycli primus, & sequens annus est secundus & ita deinceps numerabis donec perveneris ad annum præsentem, 1630. qui est 15. cycli, & habet literam C. Idem erit si diviseris 1630. in 28. & residuo 6. adjeceris 9. Vtere sequenti tabella.

page.notes: Right margin vertical inscription: "Litera in cyclo hoc procedunt ordine. Gaudet Frisia Equis, Dat Carbasa Battavus Autris." Faint show-through from the reverse page (calendar columns) is ignored. Table layout partly reconstructed; the multiplication table's rotated columns are approximate.
